statement: A guard that keeps a lint job a gate must pin what the linter is pointed at, not only how it reports. 2026-11-17: #735's workflow-lint guard refused --no-exit-codes, severity filters, continue-on-error and || true, but passed a workflow that narrowed zizmor's input from . to .github/workflows. That drops both Action definitions (21 files linted to 19) and the job stays green. The same drop came from two quieter routes: a .gitignore line, which zizmor's default collection honours, and the checkout step (path:, sparse-checkout, ref:, repository:). Fix: make the linter ignore ignore-files (zizmor --collect=all) and refuse every other route: any input but the root, a working-directory, a cd, and any checkout input but persist-credentials. Prove each refusal by running the old guard on the same mutation. Also remove any ignore written but never used (zizmor used 36 of 37).
